title.zh: 瑞士FINMA批准该国首只面向零售投资者的现货比特币ETF
title.en: FINMA approves Switzerland's first spot Bitcoin ETF for retail investors

current_state.zh: FINMA已批准瑞士首只面向零售投资者的瑞士法下现货比特币ETF，即BIT Asset Management的BBIT，预计11月在SIX Swiss Exchange开始交易，公开发行仅限瑞士；其他基金提供商也已提交比特币ETF申请。
current_state.en: FINMA has approved Switzerland's first Swiss-law spot Bitcoin ETF for retail investors, BIT Asset Management's BBIT, expected to begin trading on SIX Swiss Exchange in November with public offering restricted to Switzerland; other fund providers have also submitted Bitcoin ETF applications.

updates.title_zh: 瑞士FINMA批准该国首只面向零售投资者的现货比特币ETF
updates.title_en: 瑞士FINMA批准该国首只面向零售投资者的现货比特币ETF
updates.what_changed_zh: 瑞士FINMA批准该国首只面向散户投资者的现货比特币ETF，采用受监管的投资基金结构，在托管、运营风险和披露方面要求更严格，而非现有瑞士比特币ETP所使用的债务证券形式。
updates.what_changed_en: Switzerland's FINMA approved the country's first spot Bitcoin ETF for retail investors, using a regulated investment-fund structure with stricter custody, operational-risk and disclosure requirements instead of the debt-security format used by existing Swiss Bitcoin ETPs.

updates.what_changed_en: The approved product was identified as BIT Asset Management's Bitcoin Fund ETF (BBIT), expected to begin trading on SIX Swiss Exchange in November, with public offering restricted to Switzerland.

updates.detailed_summary_zh: Switzerland's FINMA approved BIT Asset Management's Bitcoin Fund ETF (BBIT), the country's first Swiss-law spot Bitcoin ETF for retail investors, with trading on the SIX Swiss Exchange expected to start in November and the public offering limited to Switzerland.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Switzerland's FINMA approved BIT Asset Management's Bitcoin Fund ETF (BBIT), the country's first Swiss-law spot Bitcoin ETF for retail investors, with trading on the SIX Swiss Exchange expected to start in November and the public offering limited to Switzerland.
